snippet.description:
In this lecture from Prelims Master Program (PMP) 2027, learn Polity with Babu Gunasekaran Sir, a 3-Time UPSC CSE Qualifier. The focus is on building conceptual clarity, understanding important provisions and developing the ability to apply concepts while solving Prelims questions.

Enroll in PMP 2027: https://shorturl.at/ZHr3s

PMP 2027 – The Complete Prelims System for UPSC CSE 2027 brings together structured classes, focused revision, extensive MCQ practice, mock tests, current affairs, CSAT and mentorship to help aspirants prepare systematically for Prelims.

Prepare with clarity. Practise with purpose. Stay ready for Prelims 2027.
